about: Element material video jobs, text-to-video, draft 05/11 (not run)

jobs.prompt: High-end donghua animation effect, glowing, soft bloom, rich layered detail: streams of devouring black-violet shadow energy with deep violet and crimson rim light, inky smoke tendrils and drifting void particles gather inward from the frame edges toward a small bright point in the centre, spiralling tighter and brighter, then hold as a tight glowing core. Pure black background. Locked-off static camera; the effect stays inside the frame.

High-end donghua animation effect, glowing, soft bloom, rich layered detail: a sharp release in the centre: devouring black-violet shadow energy with deep violet and crimson rim light, inky smoke tendrils and drifting void particles snaps outward in one instant flash with a thin bright shock ring, then a short glowing afterglow that fades slowly. Pure black background. Locked-off static camera; the effect stays inside the frame.

jobs.use: travel ribbon behind blades, thrusts and dashes (T), strip texture
jobs.prompt: High-end donghua animation effect, glowing, soft bloom, rich layered detail: a long ribbon of devouring black-violet shadow energy with deep violet and crimson rim light, inky smoke tendrils and drifting void particles streams horizontally from right to left across the whole frame, a band one quarter of the frame tall, tapered at both ends of the flow, same density all the time, a seamless continuous loop. Pure black background. Locked-off static camera; the effect stays inside the frame.

High-end donghua animation effect, glowing, soft bloom, rich layered detail: an impact burst in the centre: devouring black-violet shadow energy with deep violet and crimson rim light, inky smoke tendrils and drifting void particles explodes outward in a tight radial spray with a bright flash at the hit point, holds a moment, then burns down slowly. Pure black background. Locked-off static camera; the effect stays inside the frame.

Pure black background. Locked-off static camera; the effect stays inside the frame.
